name: Phone
summary: The agent uses your phone as a peripheral: a companion app pairs with the agent's gateway and exposes the phone's camera, location, notifications and screen as tools. The agent itself still runs elsewhere; the phone gives it eyes, a position and a way to reach you.
facts: Photo and clip capture, location, notifications, screen recording
Rich real-world context, but mobile OS limits background access
Camera and location access sit with a remote agent
goodFor: Snapping photos for the agent to read
Pushing alerts that need a human
watchOut: iOS and Android restrict background capture
Sensitive sensors exposed to a remote agent
how: Install the agent's companion app on the phone
Pair it with the gateway and approve the device
The agent calls phone commands as tools when a task needs them
